express line between Italy and the 
Far East, had been taken off the! 
line early this year, it will be 
recalled.

cruised between Genoa and Shang- 
hai and the Conte Rosso steamed

tures suspended, the Conte Rosso, 
which was due here July 14, will 
not make the trip. Conte Verde, 
however, is due at Colombo today, 
and is expected to reach Shanghai

Genoa on June 9. As things stand/ 
now, she is not expected to make! 
another trip to the Far East.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5422(c)-6 Date 13, 7, 42）

Foreign Affairs Station. File No.................... Date...8-7-42.

SUBJECT: Re attached notification from the Shanghai
Jewish Chronicle, dated 5-7-42.

With reference to the attached NOTIFICATION in the
Shanghai Jewish Chronicle published on the 5-7-42,
calling all independent Trade Organizations, Firms, Agents
Chief-tenants ect., to register by Order of the Japanese
Authorities with the International Committee (I.C.) 20
Nanking Road, the undersigned ascertained that such
order had been issued by the Imperial Japanese Naval
Authorities in respect of Jewish Refugees from Central-
Europe and the cause for such registration has not be
disclosed.

Translation attached.

Eggarson
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs Section.

新闻剪报
1941年6月21日

年迈流亡
推销员
上吊自杀

因流亡生活过于艰难。
朱利叶斯·格伦伯格（Julius Gruenberg），63岁，德国流亡者，于昨日上午约9时30分在其位于外滩大厦的公寓内上吊自杀。警察到达现场时，他已死亡。

朱利叶斯·格伦伯格于1938年抵达上海。他曾与维也纳的一家大型纸业公司有关联。他在上海为佩奇印刷公司（Page Printing Company）担任推销员。

虽然他没有留下遗书，但警方认为他的自杀与他最近遇到的一些商业纠纷有关。

pages.en:
S422 C
211 H 61

Ban On Immigration To
Brazil Announced Here;
Americas Are Excepted

Brazilian Consul-General In Shanghai Sends
Notes To Local Consulates Revealing
Measures; Jewish Emigres Hit

A ban on further immigration to Brazil from any part
of the world except North and South America, was today
announced by Mr. J. P. Mee, Brazilian Consul-General in
Shanghai, in identical notes addressed to the Shanghai Con-
sular Body, the various foreign consulates in Shanghai, and
to the Russian and Jewish emigre bodies here, the Shanghai
Evening Post learned.

The note issued by the Brazilian
authorities today, it is understood
explained that the ban against
further immigration into Brazil
had been ordered by the Brazilian
government, following the in-
creasing influx of emigres from
all parts of the world.
Technicians Allowed
It was stipulated in the note
that only persons from North or
South America will in future
be permitted to emigrate into
Brazil, while the only other ex-
ceptions will be in the case of
technicians or those able to place
an immigration deposit of U.S.
$20,000.
Locally, it is believed, the lat-
est restriction on immigration
placed by the Brazilian authori-
ties will chiefly affect European
Jewish refugees and, to a much
lesser extent, "white" Russian
emigres.
Affects Jews
At the same time the ban is
expected to seriously affect
several thousand European Jewish
emigres now in Japan and who
were expecting to migrate to
Brazil, in addition to many more
Jews now in Germany who have
been seeking to take up new
homes in Brazil.
Meanwhile, the Russian Emi-
grants' Committee in Shanghai
today revealed that it had re-
ceived a request from the Rus-
sian anti-Communist Committee
in Tientsin to prohibit any
"white" Russians in Shanghai to
take up residence in Tientsin.
Lacks Funds
The request, it was learned,
was based on the fact that the
Russian committee in Tientsin is
now facing a serious shortage of
funds and is unable to give
normal help required by poor
Russians already in Tientsin.
At the same time, it was stated
that Tientsin is at present facing
a serious shortage of houses, while
jobs are scarce and food prices
have mounted up considerably in
North China within the past
few months.
pages.zh:
S422 C
211 H 61

巴西宣布禁止
移民入境；
美洲除外

驻上海巴西总领事向当地各领事馆发出照会
透露相关措施；犹太流亡者受打击

据《上海晚邮报》获悉，驻上海巴西总领事 J. P. Mee 先生今日在向上海领事团、驻上海各外国领事馆以及在此地的俄罗斯和犹太流亡者团体发出的内容相同的照会中宣布，除北美和南美外，禁止世界任何其他地区向巴西进一步移民。

据悉，巴西当局今日发布的照会
解释称，鉴于来自世界各地的
流亡者涌入日益增加，巴西政府
已下令禁止进一步移民进入巴西。
允许技术人员入境
照会规定，今后仅允许来自
北美或南美的人员移民巴西，
唯一的例外情况是技术人员
或能够缴纳20,000美元移民
保证金的人。
据信，在当地，巴西当局最新
实施的移民限制将主要影响
欧洲犹太难民，并在较小程度上
影响“白俄”流亡者。
影响犹太人
与此同时，预计该禁令将严重
影响目前在日本的数千名欧洲
犹太流亡者，他们原本指望移
民巴西；此外还将影响更多目
前在德国、一直寻求在巴西安
家的犹太人。
与此同时，上海俄罗斯流亡者
委员会今日透露，它已收到天
津俄罗斯反共委员会的请求，
要求禁止任何在上海的“白俄”
居民迁居天津。
缺乏资金
据悉，提出这一请求的原因是，
天津的俄罗斯委员会目前面临
严重的资金短缺，无法为已在
天津的贫困俄罗斯人提供所需
的正常援助。
同时，据称天津目前面临严重
的住房短缺，而工作机会稀缺，
且在过去的几个月里，华北地
区的食品价格大幅上涨。

pages.en:
Refugee Passenger
Missing From Ship

Believed to Have Been
Lost Overboard

Mystery surrounds the strange dis-
appearance of Minna Grann, 27,
Jewish refugee and one of nine re-
fugee passengers in the ss. Taiyo
Maru, who failed to land when the
vessel docked here yesterday. She
was reported missing 34 hours prior
to the arrival of the ship. It is fear-
ed that she had jumped overboard in
a fit of depression owing to difficult-
ies connected with her residence in
Hongkew.

The vessel stopped after the pas-
senger was reported missing and the
vicinity was scoured for several hours
for her without result. It was learn-
ed that although she had a landing
permit, she had not succeeded in
securing a permit to live in Hong-
kew.

More than 2,000 European Jewish
refugees mostly from Soviet occupied
Poland and Lithuania, it was learn-
ed, are now in Japan, awaiting visas
to proceed to other ports. About 300
of the number is believed to have
secured the necessary sanction from
the British authorities to go to Pales-
tine.
pages.zh:
难民乘客
在船上失踪

被认为已
落水遇难

27岁的犹太难民明娜·格兰恩（Minna Grann）奇怪失踪一事充满谜团，她是“太阳丸”号（ss. Taiyo Maru）上的九名难民乘客之一，该船昨日在此靠岸时她未能上岸。据报道，她在船只抵达前34小时就已失踪。人们担心她因虹口居住困难而陷入抑郁，跳海自尽。

在该乘客被报告失踪后，船只停止航行，并在附近海域搜寻数小时，但无果而终。据悉，虽然她持有登陆许可证，但未能获得在虹口居住的许可。

据悉，目前有2000多名欧洲犹太难民（主要来自苏联占领下的波兰和立陶宛）在日本，等待签证前往其他港口。据信，其中约有300人已获得英国当局必要的批准，前往巴勒斯坦。

154

Help For Jewish
Refugees

Over 3 Million Dollars
Received Since Influx
Into Shanghai

Funds totalling $3,703,384 have been given for the assistance of European Jewish refugees in Shanghai since the influx into the city, most of this huge sum coming from abroad in foreign currency. Various committees have distributed donations to those in acute distress, the position being greatly improved by this work. Added to the total given above must be the many private contributions to Individuals which are not known, and which come to many thousands of dollars. The statistics below, issued by the Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees, gives some idea of the work being done to help these unfortunate people.

From November 15, 1938 to July 31, 1940, the following amounts have been received for the maintenance of refugees:—

From sources in Shanghai $ 224,643.94
From sources abroad .... 3,439,026.33
                         $3,663,670.27

From sources in Shanghai
for specific purposes, such
as Maternity Ward,
School-heating, Matzos
fund, Hospital fund, etc.    39,713.0
                           $3,703,384.12

It is impossible to make even a guess of the amount that has been contributed by the Shanghai community, Jewish and non-Jewish, in the way of gifts in kind and direct donations to refugees, but these should total several hundreds of thousands of dollars.

The education of about 600 children and 3,000 adults is cared for by the Shanghai Jewish Youth Association, of which Mr. Horace Kadoorie is the leading spirit. The establishment of the school at Kinchow Road and of the vocational training centre, and the running of these cost the S.J.Y.A. over 150,000.

Rehabilitation Work

A special fund was started to enable refugees to set up in business. After an amount of 18,000 had been contributed, Sir Victor Sassoon subscribed 150,000 and has continued to add to this fund, which now totals more than 238,000. This fund is managed by the International Committee for the Organization of European Immigrants in China, under the tireless and able direction of Mr. Paul Komor. Mr. Paul Komor has also collected over 102,000 for various funds, such as the Milk Fund, School Fund, Shoe-Clothing Fund, Hospital Fund, Nursery and Children Fund, etc.

It is interesting to visualize the amount of foreign currency that has flowed into Shanghai in connection with the refugee problem.

The following figures, which are vouched for, will give an approximate idea of the amount: ("approximate" because thousands of immigrants have arrived in Shanghai with funds of their own, of which there is no record).

From the above statement it will be seen that C.N.3,439,026.33 has been remitted from abroad, the principal donors being the American Jewish Joint Distribution Committee, New York. Up to the beginning of the war, there were regular remittances from the Council for German Jewry, London, from friends in Cairo and the Straits Settlements.

The above amount represents the equivalent of:

| | Aust. £ | Guilders |
|---|---|---|
| | 299 | 4,000 |
| Engl. £ | | U.S. $ |
| 20,800 | | 169,853 |
| Funds | £ | U.S. $ |

A. 2612 families received "Hicem" cheques on their arrival in Shanghai, amounting to: 600 155,711
B. Under the old Municipal Regulations immigrants could land in Shanghai with U.S.$400 or £100 cash. So far as can be traced, immigrants have brought in as landing money: 1,345 77,630
C. T.T.'s from New York and London for landing permits: 600 48,000
D. Various Banks have received T.T.'s for landing permits amounting to approximately: 100,000

Total Foreign Currencies Received

In all, therefore, the inflow of foreign currencies into Shanghai in connection with the refugees amounts, as far as can be vouched for comes to:
English .................... £23,350
Austral. ................... 299
Guilders ................... 4,000
U.S.A. ..................... $551,200

Up to the beginning of the war, a large number of refugees were receiving regular monthly remittances from relatives in England. A certain number are still receiving remittances from relatives in the U.S.A. Of these amounts there is no record but it is certain that they come to a substantial total.
pages.zh:
154

援助犹太
难民

自涌入上海以来
已收到超过300万美元

自难民涌入本市以来，已筹集总计3,703,384美元用于援助在上海的欧洲犹太难民，这笔巨款大部分是以外币形式从国外汇来的。各委员会已向处于极度困境中的人分发捐款，这项工作极大地改善了难民的处境。除了上述总额外，还有许多不为人知的对个人的私人捐助，金额达数千美元。以下由欧洲犹太难民援助委员会发布的统计数据，大致反映了为帮助这些不幸人士所做的工作。

从1938年11月15日至1940年7月31日，收到用于维持难民生活的款项如下：—

来自上海方面的来源 $ 224,643.94
来自国外的来源 .... 3,439,026.33
                         $3,663,670.27

来自上海方面
用于特定目的，如
产科病房、
学校供暖、无酵饼
基金、医院基金等    39,713.0
                           $3,703,384.12

上海社区（包括犹太人和非犹太人）以实物礼物和直接捐款形式向难民提供的资助金额甚至无法估算，但这些总额应达数十万美元。

约600名儿童和3000名成人的教育由上海犹太青年协会负责，贺拉斯·卡多里（Horace Kadoorie）先生是该协会的核心人物。在金州路（Kinchow Road）建立学校及职业培训中心，并运营这些机构，使上海犹太青年协会花费了超过150,000元。

康复工作

设立了一项特别基金，以使难民能够经商创业。在筹集到18,000元后，维克多·沙逊爵士（Sir Victor Sassoon）认捐150,000元，并继续向该基金追加捐款，目前总额已超过238,000元。该基金由在华欧洲移民组织国际委员会管理，在保罗·科莫尔（Paul Komor）先生不懈且能干的指导下运作。保罗·科莫尔先生还为各种基金筹集了超过102,000元，如牛奶基金、学校基金、鞋服基金、医院基金、托儿所和儿童基金等。

想象一下与难民问题相关而流入上海的外币数量是很有趣的。

以下经核实的数字将给出一个大致的概念（之所以称为“大致”，是因为成千上万的移民携带自有资金抵达上海，对此并无记录）。

从上述声明可以看出，有法币3,439,026.33元从国外汇入，主要捐赠者是纽约的美国犹太联合分配委员会。在战争爆发前，伦敦的德国犹太人理事会、开罗的朋友以及海峡殖民地的朋友定期汇款。

上述金额相当于：

| | 奥地利镑 | 荷兰盾 |
|---|---|---|
| | 299 | 4,000 |
| 英镑 | | 美元 |
| 20,800 | | 169,853 |
| 资金 | 英镑 | 美元 |

A. 2612个家庭在抵达上海时收到了“Hicem”支票，金额为：600 155,711
B. 根据旧的工部局规定，移民可携带400美元或100英镑现金登陆上海。据查，移民作为登陆资金带入的金额为：1,345 77,630
C. 来自纽约和伦敦用于获取登陆许可证的电汇：600 48,000
D. 各家银行收到的用于登陆许可证的电汇金额约为：100,000

收到的外币总额

因此，就有据可查的部分而言，与难民相关的流入上海的外币总额为：
英镑 .................... £23,350
澳元 ................... 299
荷兰盾 ................... 4,000
美元 ..................... $551,200

在战争爆发前，大量难民定期收到来自英国亲属的月度汇款。仍有部分人继续收到来自美国亲属的汇款。这些金额没有记录，但可以肯定总额相当可观。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 5422 C
Lor 28 8 40

May 25, 1940. Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News and Shun Pao :-

3,000 MORE JEWISH REFUGEES TO ARRIVE IN SHANGHAI

The number of Jewish refugees in Shanghai at present is a little more than 17,000. On June 6, 3,000 more Jewish refugees will arrive in Shanghai in the Italian liner Conte Verde. Permission certificates have already been issued by the S.M.C.

The immigration of Jewish refugees to Shanghai is limited by the S.M.C. and the Japanese and only those who can provide U.S. $400 security or have relatives in Shanghai or can support themselves independently are allowed to enter and live in Shanghai. Most of the Jewish refugees now in Shanghai can earn their own living and some of them can even support their relatives.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部档案室
编号 S. B. D. 5422 C
Lor 28 8 40

1940年5月25日。晨间译文。

《中美日报》和《申报》：

另有3000名犹太难民将抵达上海

目前上海的犹太难民人数略多于17,000人。6月6日，另有3,000名犹太难民将乘坐意大利邮轮“康特·韦尔德”号（Conte Verde）抵达上海。工部局已签发许可证书。

犹太难民向上海的移民受到工部局和日本方面的限制，只有能提供400美元保证金、在上海有亲属或能独立维持生计的人才被允许进入并在上海居住。目前在上海的大多数犹太难民能够自谋生路，其中一些人甚至能供养他们的亲属。

pages.en:
CHINA PRESS
1940

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 5422 C
Date 27 5 40）

Tribunal Lets Nanseck Off
With Suspended Sentence

F. H. Nanseck, 23-year-old Austrian Jewish refugee, was given a fresh start in life yesterday when the First Special District Court, which sentenced him to one and a half years' imprisonment for embezzling $120,000 from a Swiss firm suspended the sentence for three years.

Nanseck's victim was the Charles Randolph Company, where he had been employed as cashier and accountant. The defrauded amount included $107,000 Chinese currency and US$4,000, money which he received on behalf of the company from January 31 and February 20.

Following Nanseck's arraignment, the victimized firm filed a civil claim against him for the defrauded amount. This claim has been dropped, Mr. Y. D. Wong, attorney-at-law who represented the prisoner, revealed when Nanseck's release was effected.

Wife Remains Loyal

Nanseck's loyal wife, who urged him to surrender to the police early in March, was in court yesterday to hear the lenient judgment imposed upon her husband by the presiding judge.

Summing up the case, defense counsel told the Court that in his belief, the prisoner had been sufficiently punished in view of the fact that during his detention, he contracted typhoid fever, for which he was confined in the Municipal Isolation Hospital for more than three weeks.

Nanseck said he wanted "a chance to straighten everything out."

At the first hearing early in March, it was revealed that through his wife's pleading, Nanseck gave himself up to the police. She was also instrumental in returning $4,500 and US$200 to the company, the money she found her husband still possessed.

Wants To Help Mother

Nanseck personally assisted his employers in ascertaining the actual amount defrauded. He said except the sum returned to the company, the entire amount had been lost at gambling in the badlands.

At the same hearing, Nanseck stated he embezzled the money with the hope of sending for his mother who was still residing in Vienna. He produced letters to show that he had communicated with her extensively with a view to arranging for her passage here.

When the civil claim was filed against the prisoner early this month, Nanseck told the court he would seek his friends' aid in repaying the embezzled amount to the Swiss firm by making remittances to its offices in Europe.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》
1940年

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. 5422 C
日期 1940年5月27日）

法庭对南塞克判处缓刑

现年23岁的奥地利犹太难民F. H. 南塞克（Nanseck）昨日获得了重新开始生活的机会。第一特区法院此前因其从一家瑞士公司侵吞12万美元而判处其一年半监禁，但昨日宣布将该刑期缓刑三年。

南塞克的受害方是查尔斯·兰道夫公司（Charles Randolph Company），他曾在该公司担任出纳兼会计。被骗款项包括10.7万元中国货币和4,000美元，这些钱是他于1月31日至2月20日期间代表公司收取的。

在南塞克被提审后，受害公司向他对提起民事诉讼，要求赔偿被骗金额。代表被告的律师Y. D. 黄先生透露，在南塞克获释时，该项诉讼已被撤销。

妻子保持忠诚

南塞克的忠贞妻子曾于今年3月初劝其向警方自首，昨日她出庭聆听了主审法官对其丈夫作出的宽大判决。

辩护律师在总结案情时告诉法庭，他认为鉴于被告在被拘留期间感染了伤寒，并在市立隔离医院 confinement 了三个多星期，其所受惩罚已足够。

南塞克表示，他希望“有机会把一切事情理顺”。

在3月初的首次听证会上，据披露，南塞克是在其妻子的恳求下向警方自首的。她还协助将4,500元和200美元归还给公司，这笔钱是她发现其丈夫仍持有的。

希望帮助母亲

南塞克亲自协助雇主核实实际被骗金额。他表示，除了归还给公司的款项外，其余全部金额都在“不良地带”的赌博中输掉了。

在同一次听证会上，南塞克称他侵吞这笔钱是希望能接仍居住在维也纳的母亲来此。他出示了信件，表明为了安排母亲来沪的行程，他与母亲进行了广泛的通信。

当本月早些时候对被告提起民事诉讼时，南塞克告诉法庭，他将寻求朋友的帮助，通过向该瑞士公司在欧洲的办事处汇款来偿还侵吞的款项。

pages.en:
CHINA DAILY NEWS.
1940

Refugee Convicted for
Misappropriation

Convicted of misappropriation,
F. H. Nanseck, a Central European
Jewish refugee, was sentenced to 18
months' imprisonment yesterday by
the First Special District Court but
the sentence was suspended for three
years, the judge having decided to
treat him leniently. Much embezzled
money has been returned and
Nanseck promised in court to return
the remainder.

The accused, until recently a book-
keeper of Messrs. Charles Rudolph
& Co., surrendered to the police
after misappropriating $107,900 in
order to have enough funds to bring
his mother to Shanghai. His mother
is in Germany. He admitted having
lost much money in gambling while
trying to make more money.
pages.zh:
《大美晚报》
1940年

难民因挪用公款被判刑

中欧犹太难民F. H. 南塞克因犯挪用公款罪，昨日被第一特区法院判处18个月监禁，但法官决定对其从宽处理，缓刑三年。大部分被侵吞的款项已归还，南塞克在法庭上承诺将归还剩余款项。

被告直至最近一直担任查尔斯·鲁道夫公司（Messrs. Charles Rudolph & Co.）的簿记员，他在侵吞107,900元后向警方自首，目的是筹集足够资金将其母亲接到上海。他的母亲目前在德国。他承认在试图赚取更多钱财的过程中，因赌博输掉了大量金钱。

pages.en:
PRESS
MAY 24 1940

Italian Line
To Suspend
Express Run

Express liners of Lloyd Triestino, Italian shippers, will not call again at Shanghai after the Conte Verde, on its way here now, steams out of this port June 9, according to a cable received yesterday by Mr. A. Bonetta, local general agent of the company.

Until further notice, the telegram stated, the departure of express liners from Trieste has been suspended.

On receipt of the wire, Mr. Bonetta immediately informed all local travel agencies to stop bookings on Lloyd Triestino ships, and intimated that accommodation already booked may be cancelled in the near future.

Conte Biancomano and the Victoria, luxury liners which together with the Conte Verde and Conte Rosso had maintained the express line between Italy and the Far East, had been taken off the line early this year, it will be recalled.

Freighters Not Affected

Previous to the wire, Conte Verde cruised between Genoa and Shanghai and the Conte Rosso steamed only up to Trieste. With departures suspended, the Conte Rosso, which was due here July 14, will not make the trip. Conte Verde, however, is due at Colombo today, and is expected to reach Shanghai June 6, whereupon it will leave for Genoa on June 9. As things stand now, she is not expected to make another trip to the Far East.

Lloyd Triestino freighters, however, will not be affected by the order, Mr. Bonetta pointed out.

Mr. A. Bonetta yesterday stated that the possible lack of passengers from Trieste may have influenced the development. He believes that the current war in Holland, Belgium and France has created a sharp decline in bookings at Trieste, and that the main office considers the continuation of the service unprofitable.

The freighters which will remain on the run, he said, possess limited passenger accommodation.

（批：R S Patt / Roy 24/5 / J. 21/5）

新闻界
1940年5月24日

意大利轮船公司将暂停特快航线

据该公司本地总代理A. 博内塔（A. Bonetta）先生昨日收到的电报称，意大利航运商劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司（Lloyd Triestino）的特快班轮在“孔特·韦尔德号”（Conte Verde）离港后将不再停靠上海，该轮目前正在驶往上海途中，将于6月9日驶离本港。

电报称，直至另行通知为止，从的里雅斯特（Trieste）出发的特快班轮已暂停运营。

收到电报后，博内塔先生立即通知所有本地旅行社停止预订劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司的船票，并暗示已预订的舱位可能在不久的将来被取消。

回想起来，“孔特·比安科马诺号”（Conte Biancomano）和“维多利亚号”（Victoria）这两艘豪华邮轮，连同“孔特·韦尔德号”和“孔特·罗索号”（Conte Rosso），原本维持着意大利与远东之间的特快航线，但已于今年初撤出该航线。

货轮不受影响

在此电报之前，“孔特·韦尔德号”往返于热那亚和上海之间，而“孔特·罗索号”仅航行至的里雅斯特。随着出发航班的暂停，原定于7月14日抵达这里的“孔特·罗索号”将不再执行此次航程。然而，“孔特·韦尔德号”预计今日抵达科伦坡，并有望于6月6日抵达上海，随后将于6月9日启程前往热那亚。就目前情况而言，预计该轮不会再执行前往远东的航程。

博内塔先生指出，劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司的货轮将不受此命令的影响。

博内塔先生昨日表示，来自的里雅斯特的乘客可能不足可能是导致这一事态发展的原因。他认为，目前荷兰、比利时和法国的战争导致的里雅斯特的预订量急剧下降，总公司认为继续维持该航线无利可图。

他说，将继续在该航线上运营的货轮仅提供有限的客舱设施。

（批注：R S Patt / Roy 5月24日 / J. 5月21日）

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
May 22 1940

Mr. S. Zwick Heads Jews
Free Loan Society
Aim to Help Struggling
People Stressed

Mr. S. Zwick was elected chairman
of the "Gmilus Hesed Ezro," or
Jewish Free Loan Society, at its
annual meeting held in Shanghai
recently. Mr. S. M. Alcone was
elected vice-chairman, Mr. A. B.
Ginsbcurg Hon. treasurer, and Mr.
J. Keimach Hon. secretary.

The "Gmilus Hesed Ezro" Society
(350 Rue Bourgeat, Telephone 75597)
is to be noted among other charitable
organizations in Shanghai as one
which gives charity in a figurative
sense of the word; its aim is to
grant free loans to needy people
as a temporary aid on condition
that such loans are repaid by instal-
ments within a specified period.
This enables those who do not
think it fit to apply for charity, to
obtain temporary financial support
without having recourse to loans
bearing interest and its dire con-
sequences. In many cases the ap-
plicants are in need of temporary
support to establish an enterprise,
development of manufacture, pur-
chase of materials, etc. Thus the
loans give them the possibility of
doing so. In other words, the
society supports needy people by a
free loan, at the time when they
are still on their feet, so as to enable
them to remain self-supporting.

The society is supported by
monthly subscriptions and donations
of its friends, and it is hoped that
the capital will gradually be in-
creased to permit the rendering of
further service to those who are
in need.

《华北每日新闻》
1940年5月22日

S. 兹威克先生领导犹太人免息贷款协会
强调援助挣扎中的人群

在最近于上海举行的年度会议上，S. 兹威克（S. Zwick）先生当选为“Gmilus Hesed Ezro”（即犹太人免息贷款协会）主席。S. M. 阿尔科内（S. M. Alcone）先生当选为副主席，A. B. 金斯伯格（A. B. Ginsbcurg）先生当选为荣誉司库，J. 凯马克（J. Keimach）先生当选为荣誉秘书。

“Gmilus Hesed Ezro”协会（地址：蒲石路350号，电话：75597）在上海众多慈善组织中独树一帜，它以比喻意义上的方式提供慈善；其宗旨是向贫困人士提供免息贷款作为临时援助，条件是该贷款需在规定期限内分期偿还。这使得那些认为申请慈善救济不合适的人，能够获得临时财政支持，而无需诉诸带有利息及其可怕后果的贷款。在许多情况下，申请人需要临时支持以建立企业、发展制造业、购买材料等。因此，贷款使他们有可能做到这一点。换句话说，该协会在人们尚能自立之时，通过免息贷款支持贫困者，使他们能够保持自给自足。

该协会依靠其友人的月度认捐和捐款维持运作，希望资本能逐渐增加，以便为那些有需要的人提供更多服务。
